title: CI/CD 性能门禁
html:
CI/CD 性能门禁

性能预算作为代码（Performance Budget as Code）是现代工程实践的重要组成部分。将性能测试嵌入 CI/CD 流水线，让每次代码变更都经过性能验证，防止性能回归在被发现之前进入生产环境。

核心概念

术语 定义
性能门禁 CI/CD 流水线中的性能测试检查点，不达标则阻断部署
分层测试策略 PR/合并/发布三个阶段使用不同规模的测试，平衡速度与覆盖度
Smoke Test 1-5 VU 的极轻量测试，验证基本功能可用，通常 1-3 分钟完成
性能基线 已通过验证的上一版本性能数据，用于判断当前版本是否回归
回归容忍度 允许的性能变化范围，超出则触发门禁失败（如 p99 增加 < 25%）
性能预算 版本化的性能阈值配置文件，与代码一同管理和变更

性能门禁的设计原则

分层测试策略

不同阶段运行不同规模的测试，平衡速度与覆盖度：

graph LR
    PR[PR 合并] --> A[Smoke Test<br/>1 VU, 1min<br/>验证基本功能]
    Merge[合并 main] --> B[Load Test<br/>100 VU, 10min<br/>验证性能基线]
    Release[发布前] --> C[Full Test<br/>500+ VU, 60min<br/>完整压测]
    A --> |< 2min| Pass1[通过继续]
    B --> |< 15min| Pass2[通过继续]
    C --> |< 2h| Pass3[通过发布]
阶段 负载 时长 目标
PR/冒烟 1-5 VU 1-3 分钟 无错误，基本响应时间
合并主干 50-100 VU 5-15 分钟 SLO 验证，与基线对比
发布候选 200-1000 VU 30-60 分钟 完整负载验证，浸泡测试

门禁阈值设计

不同阶段使用不同严格程度的阈值：

// smoke-test/options.js（PR 阶段，宽松）
export const options = {
  vus: 1,
  duration: '1m',
  thresholds: {
    http_req_failed: ['rate<0.05'], // 错误率 < 5%
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<2000'], // p95 < 2s（宽松）
  },
};

// load-test/options.js（主干合并，标准）
export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '2m', target: 50 },
    { duration: '5m', target: 100 },
    { duration: '2m', target: 0 },
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_failed: ['rate<0.01'], // 错误率 < 1%
    http_req_duration: ['p(99)<300'], // p99 < 300ms
  },
};

// full-test/options.js（发布前，严格）
export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '5m', target: 200 },
    { duration: '20m', target: 500 },
    { duration: '20m', target: 500 },
    { duration: '5m', target: 0 },
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_failed: ['rate<0.001'], // 错误率 < 0.1%
    http_req_duration: ['p(99)<200', 'p(95)<100'], // 严格 SLO
  },
};

GitHub Actions 集成

完整工作流示例

name: Performance Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  # PR 阶段：冒烟测试
  smoke-test:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Start staging environment
        run: docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait

      - name: Run k6 smoke test
        uses: grafana/k6-action@v0.3
        with:
          filename: performance-tests/smoke.js
          flags: --env BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080

      - name: Stop environment
        if: always()
        run: docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down

  # 主干合并：标准负载测试
  load-test:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [] # 可以与其他 CI 任务并行

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to staging
        run: ./scripts/deploy-staging.sh ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Wait for deployment
        run: ./scripts/wait-for-healthy.sh https://staging.example.com

      - name: Run load test
        uses: grafana/k6-action@v0.3
        with:
          filename: performance-tests/load-test.js
          flags: >-
            --env BASE_URL=https://staging.example.com
            --out json=results.json
        env:
          K6_PROMETHEUS_RW_SERVER_URL: ${{ secrets.PROMETHEUS_URL }}

      - name: Compare with baseline
        run: |
          python3 performance-tests/compare-baseline.py \
            .perf-baseline.json results.json

      - name: Upload results as artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: performance-results
          path: results.json

      - name: Comment PR with results
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('results.json'));
            const p99 = summary.metrics.http_req_duration.values['p(99)'];
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: `## 性能测试失败\n\np99 延迟: ${p99.toFixed(1)}ms（超出 SLO）`
            });

基线管理

# 每周更新性能基线
update-baseline:
  if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest

  steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Run performance test
      uses: grafana/k6-action@v0.3
      with:
        filename: performance-tests/load-test.js
        flags: --out json=new-baseline.json

    - name: Update baseline file
      run: |
        python3 performance-tests/extract-baseline.py \
          new-baseline.json > .perf-baseline.json

    - name: Commit baseline update
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
      with:
        commit_message: 'perf: update performance baseline'
        file_pattern: .perf-baseline.json

GitLab CI 集成

stages:
  - test
  - performance

smoke-test:
  stage: performance
  image: grafana/k6:latest
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event'
  script:
    - k6 run --env BASE_URL=$STAGING_URL performance-tests/smoke.js
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - summary.json
    reports:
      junit: junit.xml # 可选：k6 JUnit 格式输出

load-test:
  stage: performance
  image: grafana/k6:latest
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  script:
    - k6 run
      --env BASE_URL=$STAGING_URL
      --out json=results.json
      performance-tests/load-test.js
    - python3 performance-tests/regression-check.py .perf-baseline.json results.json
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - results.json
    expire_in: 30 days

Jenkins Pipeline

pipeline {
    agent any

    stages {
        stage('Deploy Staging') {
            steps {
                sh './scripts/deploy-staging.sh ${GIT_COMMIT}'
                sh './scripts/wait-for-healthy.sh https://staging.example.com'
            }
        }

        stage('Performance Test') {
            steps {
                script {
                    // 运行 k6 测试
                    def exitCode = sh(
                        script: """
                            docker run --rm \
                                -v \$(pwd):/tests \
                                -e BASE_URL=${STAGING_URL} \
                                grafana/k6:latest \
                                run --out json=/tests/results.json \
                                /tests/performance-tests/load-test.js
                        """,
                        returnStatus: true
                    )

                    if (exitCode != 0) {
                        // 发 Slack 通知
                        slackSend(
                            color: 'danger',
                            message: "性能测试失败：${env.BUILD_URL}"
                        )
                        error("性能测试失败，退出码：${exitCode}")
                    }
                }
            }

            post {
                always {
                    // 保存测试结果
                    archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'results.json'

                    // 发布到 Grafana
                    sh '''
                        curl -X POST $GRAFANA_ANNOTATION_URL \
                            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                            -d "{\"text\":\"Load Test: ${GIT_COMMIT}\",\"tags\":[\"perf\"]}"
                    '''
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

性能预算配置文件

将性能预算集中管理，版本化：

// .perf-budget.json
{
  "version": "1.0",
  "updated": "2026-07-04",
  "thresholds": {
    "http_req_duration": {
      "p50": 50,
      "p90": 120,
      "p99": 200,
      "p99_9": 500
    },
    "http_req_failed": {
      "rate": 0.001
    },
    "throughput": {
      "min_rps": 500
    }
  },
  "regression_tolerance": {
    "p99_increase": 0.1,
    "error_rate_increase": 0.5
  },
  "environments": {
    "staging": {
      "base_url": "https://staging.example.com",
      "max_vus": 500
    }
  }
}

常见问题与解决

问题：测试环境与生产差异大

差异来源 影响 缓解方案
实例规格缩小 延迟偏高 记录缩放系数，调整阈值
数据量小 缓存命中率异常高 预填充数据到生产量级
网络延迟不同 延迟测量不真实 分别测量服务端和客户端延迟
连接池配置不同 并发行为不同 确保配置与生产一致

问题：测试耗时过长，阻塞 CI

解决方案：按测试类型分层执行，并限制 PR 阶段的测试规模。

# 仅在 main 分支跑完整负载测试，PR 只跑冒烟
performance-gate:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event'
      variables:
        TEST_SCRIPT: smoke.js
        MAX_DURATION: 3m
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      variables:
        TEST_SCRIPT: load-test.js
        MAX_DURATION: 15m

小结

CI/CD 性能门禁的核心思路是「分层 + 快速反馈」：PR 阶段只跑冒烟测试（1-3 分钟），主干合并跑标准负载测试（5-15 分钟），发布前跑完整压测（30-60 分钟）。每层阈值宽严递进，避免 PR 阶段误报太多。性能预算版本化管理（.perf-budget.json），基线随版本演进，保证比较的参照物始终有效。k6 的非零退出码机制让 CI 门禁集成变得零摩擦。
